name: RaijiLudomon
main_effect:
[Hand] [Main] By paying 2 cost and placing this card as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your Digimon that's level 5 or has the [Legend-Arms] trait, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks.", until the end of your opponent's turn.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an effect places a digivolution card under this Digimon, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would be deleted other than by one of your effects, by trashing 1 card with the [Legend-Arms] trait from this Digimon's digivolution cards, prevent it.
